# Synthetic contract fixtures

`contexts.ts` derives contract shapes from the supplied CausalBench guides. All 91xxx–94xxx identities are fictitious. No component code or live catalog is required. These are separate from the supplied `cb-docs/` examples, which remain untouched.

Fixtures cover static/temporal graph discovery, arbitrary supervised input/output names with two inputs reusing one alias, recursive parameter values, and the 2 datasets × 3 models × 4 metrics expansion.
